rows.text: selects the `0x58`-stride row at `01EEBCC0` by `cx >> 12` and returns 0 when its qword `+8` is null; otherwise takes bit `cx & 0xF` of word `(cx & 0xFFF) >> 4` of that array as the old bit, adds it to `edx` when `r8d` is 0 (uses `edx` alone otherwise), sets the bit and yields 1 when that value is positive or clears it and yields 0 when it is 0 or negative, writes the word back, calls `00325F40(cx, old bit, yield)` and, when `r8d` is 0 and bit 0 of the fifth (stack) argument is set, `0046A630(cx, edx)`; returns the yield

notes: 002FD420: the value test is split into three paths (negative, greater than 1, and 0/1), which reduce to 'positive sets, otherwise clears'; the row states the reduction.
